name: Ui_BeginAsyncLoad
signature: void Ui_BeginAsyncLoad(AsyncLoadOwner* self, int kind, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)

evidence: NEW: this is the create half of a pair with 0x0018F89C maybe_Ui_PollAsyncLoad, which reads exactly the fields written here (token at +0xC, kind at +0x10, active flag at +0x11, results at +0x14/+0x18) and releases the same child screen through Ui_ReleaseChildScreen. The three per-kind vtables are load-op variants, so the old 'Os_CreateAsyncWaitOp' prefix was wrong.

Renamed from the first-pass 'Ui_SetNumberText' because that name is already taken by 0x003D2A8C, the two-pane variant that reads the widget's own f_58/f_5C; this one takes the value as a parameter, so the merge had to disambiguate it as 'Ui_SetNumberText_2'.
